capabilities: Insert Markdown elements (headings, lists, code, tables, links) from a ribbon toolbar
Insert Obsidian callouts with one click, including user-defined callout types
Register custom snippets with cursor, selection and date/time placeholders
Clean up selected Markdown via an Optimize command (spacing, list markers, AI phrases, wikilinks)
Hide or reorder toolbar menus and toggle cleanup rules in settings
disambiguation: Not a Markdown linter or full editor replacement; it adds a side-panel button toolbar and a selection-cleanup command.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; README includes a Japanese-language version and a tip about Source Mode for seeing raw syntax.
problem: Obsidian requires typing Markdown syntax from memory, and text pasted from AI chat tools arrives with messy formatting, stray wikilinks and intro phrases.
summary: Markdown editing toolbar plugin that inserts headings, lists, callouts and custom snippets with one click, plus an Optimize command that cleans pasted AI text.
